title: Stale data served by user-profile-service due to cache invalidation bug
summary: Users reported seeing outdated data from user-profile-service for up to 4 hours after updates, because a recent refactor of the cache invalidation logic silently broke the invalidation trigger for one code path.
root_cause: A refactor renamed the event that triggers cache invalidation, but one caller was missed and continued publishing the old event name, which no longer had a subscriber.
fix: Fixed the missed caller, and added an integration test that asserts every code path which mutates cached data actually publishes an invalidation event.
